snapshot.name: HDFC Bank Ltd
snapshot.about: HDFC Bank Limited (also known as HDFC) is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and the world's tenth-largest bank by market capitalization as of May 2024. As of April 2024, HDFC Bank has a market capitalization of $145 billion, making it the third-largest company on the Indian stock exchanges. [1]

latest_quarter.source: screener quarterly table (standardised from exchange filing)
latest_quarter.headline: Revenue +9% YoY, NII +10%, PAT +6%

notes.text: Mar 2024 revenue jumped 66% — a step change (merger/acquisition?); CAGRs that straddle it overstate organic growth
Growth is accelerating: revenue CAGR 22% over 5y → 27% over 3y
Profit lagging revenue: PAT CAGR 20% vs revenue 27% (3y)
Lender: leverage is structural (deposits+borrowings ≈ 6.5× equity); judge on asset quality, not D/E
Lender: operating cash flow mostly reflects loan-book growth; cash conversion isn't a useful lens

red_flags.text: Profit lagging revenue: PAT CAGR 20% vs revenue 27% (3y)

business_mix.what_it_does: HDFC Bank Limited is a banking institution that provides financial services including retail deposits, business banking, loans, and corporate banking.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management remains optimistic about long term profit and loan growth outpacing the system.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Net profit has shown steady progression from Sep 2024 (18627.0 INR crore) to Sep 2026 (21537.0 INR crore).

promises.credibility: Most guidance horizons are currently pending or lack direct operational metrics in the reported financial lines to fully evaluate accuracy.

bull: Revenue growth is accelerating, showing a 22% CAGR over 5 years and a 27% CAGR over 3 years.
Latest quarter Sep 2026 performance shows positive momentum with revenue up 9% YoY and NII up 10%.
Latest quarter Sep 2026 also demonstrated profit growth, with PAT increasing by 6% YoY.
bear: Profit is lagging behind revenue growth, as seen in the 3y PAT CAGR of 20% compared to revenue at 27%.
ROCE is currently at 7.02% and ROE stands at 13.6% based on the latest metrics.
Mar 2024 revenue jumped 66% due to a step change, meaning CAGRs straddling it overstate organic growth.
